facts.claim: A budget expedition by the South route costs a climber this much in 2026: a Nepalese operator's logistics and Sherpa support, with no international guide.

versions.note: a Sherpa-supported expedition; the same section also says 30,000–50,000

source.title: Alan Arnette: How Much Does It Cost to Climb Everest? 2026 Edition

versions.note: a representative budget Nepali expedition; the reputable Nepali operators charge 40,000–50,000

source.title: Global Summit Guide: $90K vs $35K Everest

facts.claim: On a budget expedition, this many Sherpas climb with each client on summit day; before it, a client often climbs alone.

versions.note: a Sherpa usually goes with the client on summit night, and it's common to climb alone or with one Sherpa

source.title: Alan Arnette: How Much Does It Cost to Climb Everest? 2026 Edition

versions.note: one to one on summit day with most operators, one to two with some; the page's summary box says one to three

source.title: Global Summit Guide: $90K vs $35K Everest

facts.claim: A budget expedition gives each client this many bottles of oxygen.

versions.note: the fewest a climber buys, at about 650 USD a bottle

source.title: Alan Arnette: How Much Does It Cost to Climb Everest? 2026 Edition

versions.note: at 2 L/min; the Sherpas' oxygen is often pooled, not allotted

source.title: Global Summit Guide: $90K vs $35K Everest

facts.claim: A budget expedition has no international guide: the operator arranges the permits, food, gear and Sherpa support, with a simpler Base Camp, shared weather forecasts and shared communications.

versions.note: permits, food, group gear, transport and Sherpa support, but no international guides

source.title: Alan Arnette: How Much Does It Cost to Climb Everest? 2026 Edition

versions.note: no Western guide, and a lead Sherpa with 5–10 Everest summits or fewer; shared tents and a basic kitchen at Base Camp, shared public forecasts, shared communications devices

source.title: Global Summit Guide: $90K vs $35K Everest

facts.claim: A fully guided expedition by the South route, with international guides, costs a climber this much in 2026.

versions.note: typically; the dearest cost more

source.title: Alan Arnette: How Much Does It Cost to Climb Everest? 2026 Edition

versions.note: a representative premium Western expedition

source.title: Global Summit Guide: $90K vs $35K Everest

facts.claim: On a fully guided expedition, at least this many Sherpas climb with each client, besides the guides.

versions.note: one or more highly experienced Sherpas

source.title: Alan Arnette: How Much Does It Cost to Climb Everest? 2026 Edition

versions.note: throughout the climb, not only on summit day, and often one Western guide per four clients

source.title: Global Summit Guide: $90K vs $35K Everest

facts.claim: A fully guided expedition gives each client this many bottles of oxygen.

versions.note: at 3 L/min or more, sleeping at 1 L/min, and typically 3 more for the client's Sherpa

source.title: Global Summit Guide: $90K vs $35K Everest

facts.claim: A fully guided expedition climbs with international guides, typically IFMGA-certified, who decide on the turnaround, the weather and emergencies; it has a paid weather forecast and satellite communications.

versions.note: the guides typically hold IFMGA certification and decide turnaround times, weather and emergencies; the dearest companies send several, so a client never climbs alone

source.title: Alan Arnette: How Much Does It Cost to Climb Everest? 2026 Edition

versions.note: Western IFMGA lead guides with 5 or more Everest summits, a private meteorologist's daily briefings, satellite communications, individual tents and spare tents at every camp

source.title: Global Summit Guide: $90K vs $35K Everest

facts.claim: A premium expedition, with a personal guide and unlimited oxygen, costs a climber this much and more in 2026.

versions.note: Seven Summit Treks' VVIP expedition, the last time it listed a price; likely 300,000 or more now

source.title: Alan Arnette: How Much Does It Cost to Climb Everest? 2026 Edition

versions.note: Furtenbach Adventures' Signature, the top of the 2026 market, and more

source.title: Global Summit Guide: $90K vs $35K Everest

facts.claim: A premium expedition gives each client up to this many Sherpas, for the whole climb.

versions.note: two personal Sherpas on Furtenbach Adventures' Signature; five on Seven Summit Treks' VVIP, one of them a UIAGM guide

source.title: Alan Arnette: How Much Does It Cost to Climb Everest? 2026 Edition

facts.claim: A premium expedition gives each client unlimited oxygen, and at least this many bottles.

versions.note: unlimited and no fewer than this on Seven Summit Treks' VVIP, in 4-litre bottles, with 7 for each high-altitude Sherpa; unlimited on Furtenbach Adventures' Signature

source.title: Alan Arnette: How Much Does It Cost to Climb Everest? 2026 Edition

facts.claim: A premium expedition gives each client a personal guide for the whole expedition, a doctor at Base Camp and a personal cook.

versions.note: on Seven Summit Treks' VVIP, a UIAGM guide from Kathmandu and back, a doctor at Base Camp, a private cook, a satellite phone and internet; on Furtenbach Adventures' Signature, a private IFMGA guide and the team doctor

source.title: Alan Arnette: How Much Does It Cost to Climb Everest? 2026 Edition
